title: 第15章 普通仓鼠第16章 金线寻宝鼠
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
要知道长尾雉鸡和小狐狸都是一阶灵兽，小狐狸虽然在种族上有些优势，但它还是幼年体，而长尾雉鸡已经是成年体，不应该这么轻易就被杀死才对。
这时小狐狸已经叼着战利品走过来了，它昂首挺胸，尾巴翘的高高的，一副得意的样子。
就是长尾雉鸡的尾巴太长，就算叼着也拖到了地上，被它夹在两腿之间，走路的动作十分滑稽。
楚少野忍着笑，将长尾雉鸡接了过来，拍拍小狐狸的头，夸奖道：“雪无真厉害，今天我们的晚饭有着落了。”
楚少野一手拎着长尾雉鸡，一手抱着小狐狸回到山洞。
他拿出千星处理野鸡，小狐狸刚才用爪子抓到了长尾雉鸡的脖子，此时只有一层薄薄的皮相连。
如果他没看错的话，小狐狸刚才并不是随便一抓，而是用了一招技能，大部分兽类都会使用的爪击。
小狐狸被他召唤出来，满打满算也才六天而已，还没有经过训练就自行领悟了技能，堪称天赋超群。
说不定小狐狸真的能够进阶为高级的灵兽，想到这儿楚少野心情更好了，将处理干净的长尾雉鸡穿在树枝上，抹上调料稍微腌制了一下，放在火上烤了起来。
香味一阵一阵的飘散出来，小狐狸守在火堆旁，眼珠一错不错地盯着烤鸡，嘴角流下一串晶莹的口水。
楚少野失笑，点点它的鼻子，“马上就好了，再忍一忍。”
长尾雉鸡被烤的金黄酥脆，楚少野将树枝从火堆上拿了下来，撕下一根鸡腿放到干净的树叶上，递到小狐狸面前。
“还很烫，慢点吃。”
小狐狸抵挡不住烤只因的诱惑，忍不住舔了一口，烫地嗷呜嗷呜叫。
楚少野哭笑不得，只好将鸡腿撕成条，又吹了吹，等温度降下来后，才递给这只馋狐狸吃。
小狐狸早就急地跺脚了，立刻埋头大吃起来，脸都贴到了树叶上，站着吃还不够，甚至还要转着圈吃。
楚少野见它的馋样，笑道：“我看你不应该是小狐狸，应该是小馋猫。”
很快一根鸡腿就吃完了，楚少野把另一根也撕下来递给它，这时鸡腿已经凉了不少，直接吃就可以。
小狐狸犹豫了一会儿，最终还是抵挡住了鸡腿的诱惑，用爪子推了推楚少野的手腕。
“你的意思是，让我吃鸡腿？”

小狐狸点点头。
楚少野十分欣慰，还是将鸡腿放到它面前，鼓励道：“吃吧，吃完鸡腿长的快，等你长大变得更厉害了，抓更多更大的猎物，我们想吃多少鸡腿都有。”
小狐狸听到他的话眼睛一亮，灵主说的对，它要变得更厉害，抓更多的猎物，让灵主烤来一起吃！
小狐狸吃着鸡腿，楚少野则把鸡翅和鸡胸肉吃了，长尾雉鸡作为灵兽，鸡胸并没有家鸡那么柴，也挺好吃的。
吃着烤鸡的一人一狐并没有注意到，离他们十几米外的草从中，两点绿豆大的光芒正悄悄地盯着他们。
那明显是兽类的眼睛，目光里满是垂涎。
一人一狐将一整只长尾雉鸡吃的干干净净，楚少野在洞口的一边挖了一个浅坑，将食物残渣埋了进去。
收拾好这些后，他从黑玉戒中拿出一套被褥铺到地上，搂着小狐狸进入了梦乡。
这个山洞离驿道并不远，很少有野兽出没，更别说是高品阶的灵兽，是以楚少野并不怎么担心野外露宿的安全问题。
月上中天，楚少野睡的正沉，突然感受到一股力道在推自己，他睁开眼睛，正要问小狐狸怎么了，却被小狐狸用肉垫捂住了嘴巴。
小狐狸的大耳朵微微一抖，示意楚少野向洞口看去。
content_en:
You must know that the long-tailed pheasant and the little fox are both first-order spirit beasts. Although the little fox has some racial advantages, it is still a juvenile, while the long-tailed pheasant is already an adult and should not be killed so easily.
At this time, the little fox had already come over with the trophy in its mouth. It held its head high and its tail raised high, looking proud.
The tail of the long-tailed pheasant is too long. Even if it is held in its mouth, it will be dragged to the ground. It is sandwiched between its legs, and its walking action is very funny.
Chu Shaoye held back his laughter, took the long-tailed pheasant over, patted the little fox on the head, and praised: "Xue Wu is really awesome, our dinner is safe today."
Chu Shaoye returned to the cave with the long-tailed pheasant in one hand and the little fox in the other.
He took out Qianxing to deal with the pheasant. The little fox had just grabbed the long-tailed pheasant's neck with its claws. At this time, only a thin layer of skin was connected.
If he read it correctly, the little fox didn't just grab it casually, but used a skill, a claw strike that most beasts would use.
The little fox was summoned by him, and it had only been six days since he was fully prepared. He understood the skills on his own without being trained, and he was considered to be extremely talented.
Maybe the little fox can really advance to a high-level spiritual beast. Thinking of this, Chu Shaoye felt better. He threaded the cleaned long-tailed pheasant on a branch, spread it with seasoning, marinated it a little, and roasted it on the fire.
The fragrance wafted out one after another. The little fox stood by the fire, staring at the roasted chicken with his eyes fixed on it, and a string of crystal saliva flowed from the corner of his mouth.
Chu Shaoye laughed and tapped its nose, "It will be fine soon. Just bear with it a little longer."
The long-tailed pheasant was roasted until it was golden and crispy. Chu Shaoye took the branch off the fire, tore off a chicken leg, placed it on a clean leaf, and handed it to the little fox.
"It's still very hot, eat slowly."
The little fox couldn't resist the temptation of roasted food, so he couldn't help but take a lick, and it was so hot that he whined.
Chu Shaoye didn't know whether to laugh or cry, so he had to tear the chicken legs into strips and blow on them. After the temperature dropped, he gave them to the greedy fox to eat.
The little fox had already stamped his feet anxiously, and immediately started eating with his face pressed against the leaves. It was not enough to eat while standing, and he even had to eat in circles.
Seeing its greedy look, Chu Shaoye smiled and said, "I think you shouldn't be a little fox, but a little greedy cat."
Soon one chicken leg was finished, and Chu Shaoye tore off the other one and handed it to it. By this time, the chicken leg had cooled down a lot, so you could just eat it directly.
The little fox hesitated for a while, but finally resisted the temptation of the chicken legs and pushed Chu Shaoye's wrist with his paws.
"You mean, let me eat chicken legs?"
The little fox nodded.
Chu Shaoye was very pleased and put the chicken legs in front of it and encouraged: "Eat it. The chicken legs will grow faster after eating. When you grow up and become more powerful, you can catch more and bigger prey. We can eat as many chicken drumsticks as we want."
The little fox's eyes lit up when he heard his words. The spirit master was right. It wanted to become more powerful, catch more prey, and let the spirit master roast them and eat them together!
The little fox ate the chicken legs, while Chu Shaoye ate the chicken wings and breasts. As a spiritual animal, the long-tailed pheasant's chicken breasts were not as good as domestic chickens, but they were quite delicious.
One person and one fox eating roast chicken did not notice that two mung bean-sized lights were quietly staring at them in the grass more than ten meters away from them.
Those eyes were obviously those of an animal, full of salivation.
One person and one fox ate a whole long-tailed pheasant. Chu Shaoye dug a shallow hole on one side of the cave entrance and buried the food residue in it.
After packing these things, he took out a set of bedding from the black jade ring and spread it on the floor, hugging the little fox and fell asleep.
This cave is not far from the post road, and there are very few wild animals, let alone high-level spiritual beasts. Therefore, Chu Shaoye is not too worried about the safety of sleeping in the wild.
At the top of the moon, Chu Shaoye was sleeping deeply when he suddenly felt a wave ofThe force was pushing him, so he opened his eyes and was about to ask the little fox what was wrong, but the little fox covered his mouth with a flesh pad.
The little fox's big ears twitched slightly, signaling Chu Shaoye to look towards the entrance of the cave.
